notes.title: Just Ride Comprehensive Upgrade After One Year!!!
notes.content:
[b]Just Ride Comprehensive Gameplay Upgrade![/b]
Glad we can continue to update JR for more than a year. During this period, we received continuous feedback from enthusiastic players and found many problems in the game. Our goal is to polish this game into good one, so it will continue to be updated. In the course of this year, we made 2 major version updates, one DLC and 115 small version patches. My personal feeling is that the speed of the update can be faster. If there are more resources, we will speed-up the development of  content and the version. I hope everyone can support it.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118421/b5d50b69e636583c24564c1a4976dfc61a0dbf5c.jpg[/img]

Foldback Running is challenge the driving skills when you return to the check point and then return to the head.
